items.description: Concentric radial bars, one per device, each running around a gray background track.

items.name: radial-chart-gauge
items.title: Radial Chart Gauge
items.description: A 240-degree gauge arc showing an air quality reading with its value and rating below the center.

items.name: radial-chart-interactive
items.title: Radial Chart Interactive
items.description: A weekly activity view where picking a day animates three large rings and updates each ring's totals.

items.name: radial-chart-label
items.title: Radial Chart Label
items.description: Concentric radial bars with each category's name printed at the start of its bar.

items.name: radial-chart-progress
items.title: Radial Chart Progress
items.description: A three-quarter arc tracking progress toward a goal, with the count shown in the center.

items.name: radial-chart-rings
items.title: Radial Chart Rings
items.description: Three nested activity rings for move, exercise and stand, drawn as plain SVG circles.

items.name: radial-chart-stacked
items.title: Radial Chart Stacked
items.description: A half-circle arc with two series stacked end to end and the combined total beneath it.

items.name: radial-chart-text
items.title: Radial Chart Text
items.description: A single full-circle progress ring with a percentage and caption centered inside.

items.name: radial-chart-tinted
items.title: Radial Chart Tinted
items.description: Concentric radial bars whose unfilled track is a soft tint of each bar's own color.
